Build the mirror plot data frame for one spectrum pair

build_mirror_df.Rd

Query intensities are normalized to 0-100; reference intensities are used as-is (already 0-100 from the MSP library).

Usage

build_mirror_df(
  query_mz,
  query_int,
  query_feature_names,
  ref_mz_matched,
  ref_mz_full,
  ref_int_full,
  annot_lookup,
  group_ion_type,
  scale_method = "none",
  unmatched_label = "Unmatched",
  precursor_mz = NA_real_
)

Arguments

query_mz

Numeric vector of matched query feature m/z

query_int

Numeric vector of matched query feature intensities (raw scale)

query_feature_names

Character vector of feature IDs

ref_mz_matched

Numeric vector of matched library peak m/z

ref_mz_full

Numeric vector of all library peak m/z

ref_int_full

Numeric vector of all library peak intensities (0-100 scale)

annot_lookup

Named list from build_annot_lookup()

group_ion_type

Character; group-level Ion_type from direct_match

scale_method

One of "none", "sqrt", "log10"

unmatched_label

Label for unmatched reference peaks

precursor_mz

Numeric scalar; used to identify the precursor peak and restrict [M+H]+ labelling to it. Pass NA_real_ for MS1.

Value

Data frame carrying attribute scale_method

Details

NL labels come from the pipeline adduct_match field only (e.g. "[M+H-H2O]+ 274.131742" -> "[M+H-H2O]+"). The precursor peak is never relabelled.
